title: Introduce Yourself on Campus
desc: Meet a Korean classmate, introduce your name and exchange student status, and ask about their major.

title: Order at a Cafe
desc: Order a drink in Korean, choose hot or iced, and confirm the price.

title: Ask for Campus Directions
desc: Ask where the international student office is and confirm how to get there.

title: Buy a Transit Ticket
desc: Ask how to buy or recharge a transit card and confirm the fare.

title: Shop for Essentials
desc: Ask where to find an item, check its price, and pay at a convenience store.

title: Ask About Class Schedule
desc: Ask a classmate when and where the next class meets and confirm the details.

title: Explain a Food Allergy
desc: Tell restaurant staff about a food allergy, ask about ingredients, and confirm a safe option.

title: Request Dormitory Assistance
desc: Explain a dormitory problem, request assistance, and confirm next steps.
